steps.meaning: The 12 March meeting ends at 4:00 PM Eastern Time.
steps.name: meeting_ends

steps.meaning: Dr. Osei casts her vote on the motion to approve the compassionate-use request.
steps.name: vote_cast_osei
steps.uncertainty: Dr. Osei may vote yes or no; she has stated she will not approve without current safety data.

steps.meaning: Dr. Patel casts his vote on the motion to approve the compassionate-use request.
steps.name: vote_cast_patel
steps.uncertainty: Dr. Patel has consistently voted to approve when a safety review is available and favourable; the review's content may affect his vote.

steps.meaning: Sister Doyle casts her vote on the motion to approve the compassionate-use request.
steps.name: vote_cast_doyle
steps.uncertainty: Sister Doyle votes with the documented safety assessment when one has been provided; she may not have received the review before the meeting.

steps.meaning: The chair puts the motion to approve the compassionate-use request to a vote.
steps.name: motion_put

steps.meaning: The committee meeting begins at 2:00 PM Eastern Time on 12 March 2026.
steps.name: meeting_starts

steps.meaning: The safety review prepared by Lindqvist is circulated to committee members via hospital email.
steps.name: safety_review_circulated

steps.meaning: Lindqvist prepares the safety review incorporating the updated trial safety data.
steps.name: safety_review_prepared

steps.meaning: The manufacturer releases updated trial safety data on 10 March 2026 at 8:00 AM Eastern Time.
steps.name: updated_data_available
